data_retention_architecture_compatibilit.architecture_objective: Ensure Guardian Alpha data ingestion and preservation pipelines comply with vendor termination and non-redistribution clauses without compromising scientific reproducibility.

raw_vendor_tier.content_type: Raw JSON/CSV API responses, vendor bar tables, tick streams
raw_vendor_tier.purge_protocol: Must be purgable via a single command (e.g. `python scripts/purge_vendor_cache.py`) upon subscription termination without breaking git history or tracked evidence

derived_analytics_tier.content_type: Portfolio weights, daily returns $R_{E0,t}$ and $R_{D2,t}$, shortfall metric $d_t$, execution timestamps, SHA-256 nonces, Newey-West test statistics
derived_analytics_tier.legal_characterization: Proprietary derived work product. All major vendor terms (Tiingo, Polygon, Alpaca, IBKR) recognize algorithmic signals, weights, and performance statistics as the subscriber's intellectual property, exempt from raw data purge mandates.

reproducibility_vs_purge_resolution.conflict: If raw market data must be deleted upon subscription termination, how can third parties reproduce the exact research results?
reproducibility_vs_purge_resolution.resolution: Guardian Alpha relies on cryptographic SHA-256 digests of the raw inputs and fully recorded deterministic event logs. Independent verifiers with their own valid vendor subscriptions can re-download the same date range and verify that their freshly ingested raw data hashes match Guardian Alpha's pre-recorded input digests. This preserves scientific reproducibility without committing copyrighted exchange data to the repository.

technical_safeguards.safeguard_1: .gitignore enforces exclusion of all *.cache, tiingo_cache/, and provider_cache/ directories.
technical_safeguards.safeguard_2: Pre-commit hooks or staging manifests inspect all untracked files to prevent accidental staging of raw market data.
technical_safeguards.safeguard_3: Audit ledgers store only statistical metrics, Decimal accounting balances, and paired difference series.
